narr: Several rounds of thunderstorms brought severe weather hazards to the state of Utah, including flash flooding in southern and eastern Utah, and damaging winds, hail, and a tornado in Northern Utah.
ev: Zion National Park rangers reported flash flooding in slot canyons between Temple of the Sun and Twins.

Capitol Reef National Park officials reported 6 inches of water flowing across state Route 24 in several locations east of Fruita. UDOT also reported 6 inches of water flowing across state Route 24 between mileposts 81 and 84.

A significant flash flood occurred in the town of Hanksville, with nearly every structure in town impacted by flooding. Floodwaters were reportedly as deep as 6 feet in places. Rainfall totals were 1.2 inches in Hanksville, and were as high as 1.7 inches in the Henry Mountains. In Capitol Reef National Park, 1.66 inches fell.
The Escalante River gauge near Escalante rose from 375 CFS to a peak of 1840 CFS.
